in_sanskrit.name: Eshurvansh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord Shiva's descendant
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Eshurvansh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Eshurvansh is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Eshu’ meaning Lord Shiva and ‘Rvansh’ meaning descendant. This name signifies a person who is a devout follower of Lord Shiva and is believed to be blessed with his divine grace and protection.
